Can we lock a 60-minute call (legal + procurement + a Redwood engineering or product rep) next week?

- Wed 2026-08-26: 10:00–12:00
- Thu 2026-08-27: 13:00–16:00

- Tue 2026-08-25: 15:30–16:00 (30-min legal triage) + Thu 2026-08-27: 13:30–14:30 (60-min procurement)

- SOC 2 summary / last audit date
- Data flow diagram for the pilot (high level)
